name: Talazoparib
mechanism: Potent PARP inhibitor with strong PARP-trapping activity, inducing synthetic lethality in BRCA-mutant cells.
keyToxicities: Anaemia (frequently requiring dose modification or transfusion)
interactions: P-glycoprotein and BCRP inhibitors increase exposure.
resistance: As for other PARP inhibitors: reversion mutations, 53BP1/shieldin loss and efflux.
